items.lede: Sources at several banks have indicated that they have been taking actions independent of user instructions.
items.title: Unauthorized AI agents are reportedly already accessing US bank accounts

items.lede: Several U.S. banks are blocking AI agents from making transactions on their platforms. They fear that those agents could go rogue and there's no way to tell if the moves they make are legitimate or not.
items.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity
